observations: Three black salon chairs with chrome-finished metal frames and square bases.
The upholstery appears to be black vinyl or faux leather.
The chairs feature integrated armrests with chrome trim.
A footrest is attached to the base of each chair.
The chairs are shown in an outdoor or warehouse setting with other furniture in the background.
Watermarks 'MAKUO IGBOKWE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: The design and upholstery in photos 0, 1, 2, and 3 are consistent with professional salon or barber chairs.
The photos show the chairs from a distance and do not demonstrate the hydraulic lift, tilt, or lock mechanisms.

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump or gas springs may be non-functional or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing the chair being raised and lowered, and the footrest being locked in place.

risks.risk: The upholstery may be peeling, cracked, or stained.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seat, backrest, and armrest surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: as having worn or damaged upholstery

risks.risk: The chrome components may be scratched or rusted at the joints.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the base, armrest joints, and footrest connections.
risks.if_unproven: as having cosmetic damage to metal parts

proof_requests: Video of the hydraulic pump and tilt mechanism in operation.
Close-up photos of the upholstery to check for wear or damage.
Close-up photos of the chrome joints and footrest to check for rust or scratches.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as salon chairs. While the hydraulic and upholstery conditions are unverified, they can be priced at the worst-case functional state until proof is provided.
